name: clockodo
description: Your Clockodo entries in your Raycast

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1

ai.instructions: If you only have a number id for a project or customer, use the get-project or get-customer tool to retrieve the entity, they have a name property. If you have the name, you can directly return it.
